headline: Omar Althobaiti climbs from 1450th to 94th on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Omar Althobaiti gained 5.28 to reach 35.00, moving from 1450th to 94th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The climb moves the team into the top 100 of the board. Public standings remain provisional, and medals are decided on the private board.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
